name: utmail
systemHint: You have read-only UofT Outlook access through `utmail` (alias `uoftmail`, source at <exocortex-source-dir>/external-tools/utmail). Run `utmail -h`; prefer bounded reads and --json. Auth uses LOCAL vimbrowser. `utmail login --from-vimbrowser --tab ID` imports one exact signed-in Outlook tab; --persistent uses a separate renewable context. Never print bearer tokens/cookies. This tool cannot send/delete email. Shared state defaults to ~/Desktop/uoft/.private/utmail. Installing does not enable background monitoring.
